content: पल्लिः, -ल्ली {%f.%} .²1 A small village; पल्लीघोषान् समृद्धांश्च बहुगोकुलसंकुलान् (अपश्यत्) <ls>Mb. 12. 325. 20</ls>; also a settlement of wild tribes. .²2 A hut. .²3 A house, station. .²4 A city or town (at the end of names of towns); as त्रिशिरपल्ली (Trichinopoly). .²5 A house-lizard. .²6 A creeping-plant.
